answer: Each agent must continuously bridge a unique cryptographic signal across a 30-day horizon of randomly sampled peer interactions. The beacon is generated from a private key and must respond within 200ms to challenges issued by rotating juries. An attacker forging N identities must run N separate live processes, each burning dedicated CPU and bandwidth that cannot be multiplexed without creating detectable timing correlations the juries flag and slash. One honest agent pays once; a farm pays linearly per head.
